Calibration from the inward tick marks against log10(kHz), 1-150 kHz; max residual 3.1 px = 0.011 decade, about 2.6% in frequency. The page is a 300 dpi scan and is slightly skewed, so the frame position is fitted as a function of row/column before ticks are sought.

Definition: Threshold intensity, dB SPL, read off the panel's own linear intensity axis
Note: Digitised, not printed. Each panel is calibrated on its own five inward ticks (0, 20, 40, 60, 80 dB); the three panels give 2.84, 2.78 and 2.81 px/dB, so one pixel is about 0.4 dB and values carry roughly +/-1 dB. Check: this paper's Results text gives NL 21 a high-frequency limit of 115 kHz and a low-frequency limit averaging 7 kHz; the digitised Noctilio curve crosses 60 dB at about 120 kHz and about 5-6 kHz.
